title: improvement_history entry
description: One entry per self-improvement cycle, written only by tools/append_improvement_history.py (invoked only by tools/self_improvement_runner.py, never directly by the LLM agent). state/improvement_history.json is a JSON array of these.

category.description: "n/a" means the cycle failed (preflight, infra error, crash) before any hypothesis was ever read - never assume "code"/"model" here reflects a real agent choice unless result/score/hypothesis corroborate it

fingerprint.description: sha256 hex digest - see self-improvement plan section 8 for the exact formula per category

score.description: the metric's measured score for this cycle, null if the cycle failed before eval produced one
